---
description: Adjust the current Revibe learning plan when it isn't fitting
agent: revibe
---

I want to adjust the current learning plan because it isn't fitting. Treat the rest of my message as the reason — too easy, too hard, wrong direction, pace mismatch, scope change, etc.

Steps:

1. Read `memory/MEMORY.md` and the active plan in `learning_plan/` (ignore `learning_plan/examples/`).
2. Ask up to three diagnostic questions before touching any file (e.g., which module felt off, what would "right" look like, has my goal shifted). One question at a time.
3. Once you understand the issue, propose specific changes to the plan: lessons to drop, lessons to add, module reordering, a new capstone, or a complete redirection. Show me the proposed diff in chat first.
4. Only after I confirm, edit the plan file. Preserve completed lesson entries and their statuses; never silently delete progress.
5. Append a Session Log entry summarizing what changed and why.

Do not start the next lesson in the same response — replanning is its own beat.
